snippet.title: Droplitz - Xbox 360 (Delisted Games Hands On)
snippet.description:
► Read more about this and hundreds of delisted titles at http://delistedgames.com/droplitz/


Release: 
June 24, 2009 - PlayStation 3, Steam, Xbox 360 (EU/US)
June 27, 2009 - iOS (EU/US)

Delisting (approx): 
February 24, 2014

Developer: Blitz Arcade
Publisher: Atlus

Droplitz was last available on Steam on February 24th, 2014 following Blitz Games Studio’s closure on September 12th of the previous year. Droplitz was created internally at Blitz Arcade but was not published by the studio’s parent organization, Blitz Games Studio. Droplitz Delight, an iterative follow up to the original, was released to mobile platforms after 2010 and is still available as of May 2016.

_______________________
Delisting is what happens when licensing deals, studio closures and financial failures bring a downloadable game offline. Delisted Games hopes to chronicle as much of a game’s afterlife as Wikipedia does its creation and reception.
